scripts.test: node tooling/repo-standards/run-workspaces.mjs test && npm run weapons:reach -- --check
scripts.test:placement: cd tooling/world-generation && python3 -m pytest -q -p randomly $(python3 -c "import importlib.util;print('-n=auto --dist=loadgroup' if importlib.util.find_spec('xdist') else '')") $(python3 scripts/select_tests.py placement)
scripts.test:pipeline: cd tooling/asset-pipeline && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:randomly $(python3 -c "import importlib.util;print('-n=auto' if importlib.util.find_spec('xdist') else '')") $(python3 ../world-generation/scripts/select_tests.py pipeline)
scripts.test:workbench: cd tooling/placement-workbench && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:randomly $(python3 -c "import importlib.util;print('-n=auto' if importlib.util.find_spec('xdist') else '')") $(python3 ../world-generation/scripts/select_tests.py workbench)
scripts.test:water: cd tooling/world-generation && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:randomly $(python3 -c "import importlib.util;print('-n=auto --dist=loadgroup' if importlib.util.find_spec('xdist') else '')") $(python3 scripts/select_tests.py water)
